_note: Two-plane decomposition for GH #581 (ui-tabs vertical orientation) + GH #586 (overflow=menu) — one intake, one LLD (lld/tabs-vertical-overflow.lld.md), two sequential build slices (same three files). OUTSIDE-IN nodes = the surfaces the change touches (tabs.ts / tabs.css / tabs.md / the two test suites / the site demo page). INSIDE-OUT actions = what the shipped control must DO in each new mode. Crossed via hosts. plan:true — each leaf carries the checkable acceptance predicate that gates its build slice. Reuse-heavy, no novelty leg: roving-focus trait (connect-resolved axis, ADR-0095/toolbar precedent), the shipped ui-menu (sibling-control import precedent), @agent-ui/icons setIcon (paddles precedent), the #536/#540/#542/#543 spacing law + probes. Zero new tokens, zero new events, no ADR (LLD §9). Catalog exposure deferred — no a2ui nodes by design.

nodes.label: props schema — orientation ['horizontal','vertical'] default horizontal, overflow ['scroll','menu'] default scroll, both reflected enums
nodes.accept: npm test tabs — jsdom: unset reads defaults; set reflects and round-trips; out-of-vocabulary writes fail open to default; existing selected/fill/surface props byte-identical (negative)

nodes.label: vertical wiring — aria-orientation on the [data-part=tablist] div iff vertical; rovingFocus orientation connect-resolved from this.orientation
nodes.accept: npm test tabs — jsdom: vertical ⇒ strip has aria-orientation='vertical'; horizontal ⇒ NO aria-orientation attribute (byte-identical default DOM). npm run test:browser tabs shard: under vertical, ArrowDown/ArrowUp move selection+focus (selection-follows-focus), ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are inert, Home/End unchanged — both engines

nodes.label: visible-tab set + roving index-space mapping — #visibleTabs() excludes [data-overflowed]; initialIndex/syncIndex return the selected tab's VISIBLE-list position (-1 ⇒ trait no-update); onMove maps visible index back to full index
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser tabs shard: with tabs hidden by fit, an arrow walk visits exactly the visible tabs in DOM order and never focuses a hidden tab; after a click on a mid tab, the next arrow steps from it (syncIndex mapping) — both engines

nodes.label: [data-part=overflow] part — lazily created iff overflow==='menu' at connect: ui-menu wrapping a <button aria-label='More tabs'> with setIcon('dots-three'); proxies maintained in the menu's live [data-part=panel] with role=menuitem, tabindex=-1, data-value=identity, textContent label, disabled mirrored
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser tabs shard: overflow='menu' + bounded strip ⇒ the shell has exactly one [data-part=overflow] ui-menu whose trigger is a button with aria-haspopup='menu' and an accessible name; the open panel lists exactly N-K proxy menuitems whose data-values equal the overflowed tabs' identities; overflow='scroll' ⇒ NO overflow part exists (negative)

nodes.label: event containment + proxy-commit relay — stopPropagation on the inner menu's select/toggle/close at the ui-menu element; menu select maps data-value → full index → the existing #commit path
nodes.accept: npm test tabs — jsdom: a CustomEvent('select', {bubbles:true, composed:true}) dispatched from inside the overflow part never reaches a listener on ui-tabs with the menu's detail; menu toggle/close likewise contained. npm run test:browser: committing a proxy fires exactly ONE ui-tabs select (spy count 1) with the TAB's {value,index} detail

nodes.label: #applyFit() — ResizeObserver on the strip (typeof-guarded for jsdom); available = inline-size (horizontal) / block-size (vertical); reserve = resolved --ui-tabs-tab-height + one gap (token-derived, never trigger-measured); cached full-set tab sizes measured at connect pre-hide + one document.fonts.ready remeasure (vertical needs no cache — uniform row height); selected always pinned; K=N ⇒ overflow part hidden; K=1 floor
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser tabs shard: a fixed 320px strip with wide tabs shows K visible tabs + the trigger, and Σ(visible widths)+gaps+reserve ≤ 320 while adding the next cached width overflows it (fit math pinned); resize wider ⇒ trigger hidden and all N tabs visible; resize is deterministic across repeated identical sizes (no oscillation — same K on re-observe); setting selected (programmatic) to an overflowed tab's key makes it visible as the last slot WITHOUT any select event — both engines

nodes.label: vertical block — :scope[orientation=vertical]: shell flex row, strip flex column (flex:none, max-content inline-size), visible panel flex:1 min-inline-size:0; divider border-inline-end; indicator ::after inset-inline-end vertical bar; labels justify-content:flex-start; strip overflow-y:auto; [fill] composition (shell row block-size:100%, strip pinned scroll column)
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser tabs shard: under vertical the strip's bounding box sits inline-start of the visible panel (whole-shape assertion); the selected tab's indicator paints on its inline-end edge (probe the ::after box); the strip's border-inline-end is 1px and its border-block-end is 0; a tab's computed padding-inline is '0px' both edges (the #536 negative extended); row gap resolves 16px at density 1 — both engines

nodes.label: menu-mode block — :scope[overflow=menu]: shell grid ('strip trigger / panel panel' horizontal, 'strip panel / trigger panel' vertical); trigger square at var(--ui-tabs-tab-height); ui-tab[data-overflowed]{display:none}; strip overflow:clip; overflow part display:none when K=N
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser tabs shard: in menu mode the trigger's box height equals the tab row height and sits at the strip line's inline-end (horizontal) / the strip column's block-end (vertical×menu corner smoke); an overflowed tab has no client rects; the strip never scrolls (scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth after fit) — both engines

nodes.label: default-mode byte-identity — horizontal+scroll (±fill) untouched
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser tabs shard: the existing #542 probes (16px column-gap, zero tab padding-inline) and the fill negative control run UNMODIFIED and green; a default ui-tabs renders no overflow part, no grid display, no aria-orientation — both engines

actions.label: expose orientation and overflow as additive reflected enum props with byte-identical defaults
render the strip as a vertical list beside the panel, with aria-orientation and the Up/Down arrow axis per APG
move the divider and selected-tab indicator to the inline-end edge under vertical while keeping the #536 zero-padding law
collect tabs that do not fit behind a dots-three trigger that opens a shipped ui-menu of proxy items, never reparenting a tab
commit a proxy through the one existing selection path, emitting exactly ONE select and surfacing the tab as the last visible slot
contain the inner menu's event vocabulary so ui-tabs' surface stays exactly {select}
measure fit against cached full-set sizes with a token-derived trigger reserve, axis-flipped under vertical, immune to oscillation
keep roving focus over exactly the visible tabs, with the trigger as its own Tab stop
hold every existing consumer byte-identical under the defaults, including the #542 probes and fill
document the new surface in the descriptor and show both modes on the site demo page

edges.why: the roving axis and aria-orientation read the orientation prop n3 declares
the overflow part is created only when the overflow prop n3 declares reads 'menu'
the vertical CSS block keys off the reflected [orientation=vertical] attribute n3 provides
the menu-mode CSS block keys off the reflected [overflow=menu] attribute n3 provides
the containment/relay listeners attach to the ui-menu element n6 creates
#applyFit rebuilds the proxy list inside the panel n6 owns and toggles the part's visibility
roving's visible-set accessor reads the data-overflowed stamps #applyFit writes
the CSS hides exactly the tabs #applyFit stamps and sizes the trigger the reserve assumes
the descriptor rows mirror the props schema (trip-wire n14 cites)
the jsdom suite asserts the wiring n4 lands
roving-over-visible needs real focus order — browser suite
fit math needs real layout — browser suite
vertical geometry probes need real layout — browser suite
trigger geometry + clip probes need real layout — browser suite
byte-identity negatives run in the same browser shard
the demo specimens set the attributes n3 exposes
